tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get this business's contact information: address, phone, email, and social profiles from the site's structured data.

tools.name: get_navigation
tools.description: Get the site navigation menu structure with page titles and URLs.

menu.description: Menu location slug (e.g. "primary", "footer"). Omit for the primary menu.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get the full content and metadata of a specific page or post by its URL path or ID.

path.description: URL path relative to site root (e.g. "/about/" or "/blog/my-post/").

id.description: Post/page ID. Use path OR id, not both.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Get basic information about this website: name, description, URL, language, and available content types.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List recent published posts, optionally filtered by category or tag.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search this website for pages and posts matching a keyword query. Returns titles, URLs, excerpts, and dates.

post_type.description: Filter by content type. Default: any.
